title: Item 7: frozen 1.120.0 stamp or no version at all
context: The issue says take the version out of .config.example and hook.mjs. Released paqad treats a missing stamp as not newer and would overwrite those files. The plan proposed one frozen 1.120.0 value in each.

options.label: Keep the one frozen 1.120.0 value
options.trade_off: Not stated when the decision was opened.

options.label: Take the version out completely and accept that 1.119.0 and older overwrite these files
options.one_line_preview: Take the version out completely and accept that 1.119.0 and older overwrite these files
options.trade_off: Not stated when the decision was opened.

rationale: Owner, relayed by the orchestrator: "No body is using this now or updated so we can remove it fully, I do not want to pollute the file". Overrules the plan and the chief recommendation. No frozen literal in .config.example or hook.mjs. Protection against released versions is knowingly dropped; new code uses catalog_version, the launcher revision and schema_version.
